title: Steve Jobs Accidentally Invented the iPhone 📱
speaker: Steve Jobs
content:
# Steve Jobs Accidentally Invented the iPhone 📱

**Source**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zlYfhibMQ1Q

**Transcribed**: 2025-12-26 13:41

---

**[Speaker 1]**: Steve Jobs accidentally invented the iPhone because he hated this dude at Microsoft.
You can't make this stuff up.
So basically, there was this guy at Microsoft, Steve's wife's friend's husband.
And anytime Steve interacted with him, he'd come back to Apple pissed off.
One time Steve came back irate because this guy said Microsoft had solved tablet computing with pens.
Steve's response to his teammates after some expletives, let's show them how it's really done.
First thing, they're idiots.
Why would you use a stylus?
It's big and cumbersome and easy to lose.
We're born with 10 styli.
So the designers get to work and they make this huge touchscreen demo that beams a projector down onto a table, and you can drag things around with your finger.
So then Steve asks, can we shrink this down to pocket size?
And when the designers cooked up the next version, Steve was amazed.
The demo was a handheld tablet with a basic contact list.
You could scroll through the list and tap call.
Steve says, pause the tablet.
Let's make a phone.
Oops, Microsoft.
